audits.mathematicalReason: The pentagon is a rectangle of area 4(2π+1) with a right triangle of area 4 removed, giving total area 8π. For P=(x,y), angle APB is obtuse exactly when (A−P)·(B−P)=x²−4x+y²−2y<0, or (x−2)²+(y−1)²<5. This is the disk with diameter AB. Its half on the pentagon side of AB lies entirely within the pentagon and has area 5π/2. Therefore the probability is (5π/2)/(8π)=5/16. Both proposed geometric routes are valid, but the central uniform-area probability model is absent from the supplied catalog scopes; the unresolved mapping limitation should be preserved.
